title: M-QAM MIMO Maximum-Likelihood Detection with QAOA: ML-Rate Offline Angle Design and Correlated Infinite-Size Spin-Glass Models
summary: The quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) targets NP-hard maximum-likelihood (ML) detection in multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. Existing $M$-ary quadrature amplitude modulation (M-QAM) detectors design angles by expected Ising energy: online per instance, warm-started, or ramped, while train-once designs remain B/QPSK-only or block-local, leaving M-QAM without a size-scalable benchmark.
